"""Parser for Meridian CRM audited-column configuration files."""

from __future__ import annotations


def audited_columns(cfg_text: str) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
    """Return audited columns grouped by table from an audit_config.cfg string."""
    result: dict[str, set[str]] = {}

    for line in cfg_text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue

        parts = stripped.split()
        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] != "AUDIT":
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid audit configuration line: {line!r}")

        _, table, column = parts
        result.setdefault(table, set()).add(column)

    return result
